title: xrMHW: parallel, out-of-core detection of surface and subsurface marine heatwaves
description: xrMHW applies the marine heatwave definition of Hobday et al. (2016) to every cell of gridded ocean datasets, from a single time series to (time, depth, latitude, longitude) fields. Built on xarray and Dask, it processes datasets larger than available memory chunk by chunk and returns the daily intensity, severity, duration, category and cumulative intensity on the input grid. Its results are validated against the reference implementation marineHeatWaves.
